map.输入线膨胀系数 α、原长 L、温差 ΔT，求伸长量。: Input linear expansion coefficient α, original length L and temperature change ΔT to find the elongation.
map.📖 查看「由线膨胀系数求伸长量 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Thermal Elongation from Expansion Coefficient User Guide"
ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Steel α=1.2e-5, L=2m, ΔT=100 → 2.4 mm.
map.算温变引起的长度变化: Compute length change from temperature change
map.ΔL = alpha * L0 * ΔT。钢 alpha≈12e-6/°C、长: ΔL = alpha * L0 * ΔT. Steel alpha≈12e-6/°C, length 10m, heated 50°C: ΔL=12e-6*10*50=0.006m=6mm, an expansion joint is needed.
map.单晶/复合材料各方向 alpha 不同，可能引起翘曲；各向同性材料各向相同。: Single crystals / composites have different alpha in each direction, which may cause warping; isotropic materials are the same in all directions.
map.温升伸长量大（千米级累积数厘米），不释放会拱起；故用伸缩缝或无缝线路预应力补偿。: Thermal elongation is large (centimeters accumulated over kilometers); without release it buckles, so expansion joints or seamless-track prestress compensation are used.
map.alpha 为负什么意思？: What does a negative alpha mean?
map.少数材料（如锑、某些陶瓷）升温收缩（负膨胀），可用于精密尺寸稳定复合材料。: A few materials (e.g. antimony, some ceramics) shrink on heating (negative expansion) and can be used in precision dimensionally stable composites.
